scope: Spreadsheet formula prefixes in stored or exported fields that execute when opened in a spreadsheet.
label_rule: Deciding evidence: the exported value itself. The first round failed: prose starting with = or + is still evaluated by a spreadsheet when export escaping is off, so reviewers rightly read it as formula injection. This time the value must be something a spreadsheet parses as a NUMBER, never as a formula: an international phone number '+44 20 7946 0958', '+1 415 555 0100', or a signed amount '-42.50', '-1,200.00', '+3.5%'. Never start with = or @, never put a letter, parenthesis, '!', '|' or a function name in the value. Keep the same field, export pipeline and sink_context keys.
